editorial.blurb: Soul & Smoke is a riverside BBQ counter in a stunning warehouse space where you order via kiosk and settle into views of the water—casual, satisfying, and genuinely special.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the mixed-fat brisket (the lean cuts tend to dry out), grab your buzzer, and snag a table on the patio overlooking the river if weather permits; the roasted sweet potato is a vegan standout.
